comment: Local advisory database used by the built-in scanner. Entries are matched against the detected OpenCloud version using the half-open range [introduced, fixed). No public GHSA or CVE has been published for opencloud-eu/opencloud so far, so this database ships empty on purpose. Add your own entries here, or point --vulnerability-feed at a JSON feed - the native format, the GitHub Advisory API format and the OSV format (https://api.osv.dev/v1/query) are all understood.

advisories.title: Unmaintained OpenCloud release
advisories.description: The detected release no longer receives security fixes. This entry is reported by the scanner itself when the release schedule flags the version as end-of-life; it is listed here for documentation only and is never matched by version range.
